create_TFClient: create a TFClient instance to connect to a Reverb replay server by address
sample_from_table: sample an item from a Reverb replay table with specified data dtypes
insert_into_tables: insert a trajectory into one or more Reverb tables with priorities
update_priorities: update priorities of existing items in a Reverb replay table by keys
get_server_address: get the server address of a TFClient instance
